---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL SeqThmHelper == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
LOCAL FinSetThmHelper == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL FinExtThmHelper == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems
AgentEntry == [term : Nat, type : {ValueEntry, ConfigEntry}, config : SUBSET Server, value : Values \cup {Nil}]
AgentConfigCount(agentS) == Cardinality({agentK \in (Max(commitIndex[agentS], committedConfigIndex[agentS])+1)..Len(log[agentS]) : log[agentS][agentK].type = ConfigEntry})
AgentConfigSafetyAll == \A agentS \in Server : AgentConfigCount(agentS) <= 1
AgentTypeOK == /\ commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ committedConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ latestConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ log \in [Server -> Seq(AgentEntry)]
AgentLatestLink == \A agentS \in Server : latestConfigIndex[agentS] = LastConfigIndex(log[agentS])
AgentInd == AgentTypeOK /\ AgentLatestLink /\ AgentConfigSafetyAll
AgentConfigCountP(agentS) == Cardinality({agentK \in (Max(commitIndex'[agentS], committedConfigIndex'[agentS])+1)..Len(log'[agentS]) : log'[agentS][agentK].type = ConfigEntry})
THEOREM HelperBridgeIsFiniteSet == \A agentS : FinSetThmHelper!IsFiniteSet(agentS) = IsFiniteSet(agentS)
PROOF BY DEF FinSetThmHelper!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet
THEOREM HelperBridgeCardinality == \A agentS : FinSetThmHelper!Cardinality(agentS) = Cardinality(agentS)
PROOF BY DEF FinSetThmHelper!Cardinality, Cardinality
THEOREM HelperSetMaxEqThm == \A agentS : SetMax(agentS) = FinExtThmHelper!Max(agentS)
PROOF BY DEF SetMax, FinExtThmHelper!Max
THEOREM HelperInitTypeOK == Init => AgentTypeOK
PROOF
<1>1. ASSUME Init PROVE commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  <2>1. commitIndex = [s \in Server |-> 0] BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>2. [s \in Server |-> 0] \in [Server -> Nat] BY DEF Nat
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. ASSUME Init PROVE committedConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  <2>1. committedConfigIndex = [s \in Server |-> 0] BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>2. [s \in Server |-> 0] \in [Server -> Nat] BY DEF Nat
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. ASSUME Init PROVE latestConfigIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  <2>1. latestConfigIndex = [s \in Server |-> 0] BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>2. [s \in Server |-> 0] \in [Server -> Nat] BY DEF Nat
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>4. ASSUME Init PROVE log \in [Server -> Seq(AgentEntry)]
  <2>1. log = [s \in Server |-> <<>>] BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>2. <<>> \in Seq(AgentEntry) BY SeqThmHelper!EmptySeq DEF AgentEntry
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgentEntry
<1>5. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF AgentTypeOK
THEOREM HelperInitLatestLink == Init => AgentLatestLink
PROOF
<1>1. ASSUME Init, NEW s \in Server PROVE latestConfigIndex[s] = LastConfigIndex(log[s])
  <2>1. latestConfigIndex = [x \in Server |-> 0] BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>2. latestConfigIndex[s] = 0 BY <2>1
  <2>3. log = [x \in Server |-> <<>>] BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>4. log[s] = <<>> BY <2>3
  <2>5. LastConfigIndex(log[s]) = 0 BY <2>4 DEF LastConfigIndex, ConfigIndices
  <2>6. QED BY <2>2, <2>5
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF AgentLatestLink
THEOREM HelperInitSafetyAll == Init => AgentConfigSafetyAll
PROOF
<1>1. ASSUME Init, NEW s \in Server PROVE AgentConfigCount(s) <= 1
  <2>1. log[s] = <<>> BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>2. Len(log[s]) = 0 BY <2>1
  <2>3. commitIndex[s] = 0 BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>4. committedConfigIndex[s] = 0 BY Init DEF Init, ProtocolInit
  <2>5. Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s]) = 0 BY <2>3, <2>4 DEF Max
  <2>6. (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) = {} BY <2>2, <2>5
  <2>7. {k \in (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) : log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry} = {} BY <2>6
  <2>8. Cardinality({k \in (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) : log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry}) = 0 BY <2>7, FinSetThmHelper!FS_EmptySet, HelperBridgeCardinality DEF AgentConfigCount
  <2>9. QED BY <2>8 DEF AgentConfigCount
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF AgentConfigSafetyAll

  <2>2. commitIndex' = commitIndex BY Timeout(i) DEF Timeout

  <2>5. latestConfigIndex' = latestConfigIndex BY <2>3 DEF configVars

  <2>2. configVars' = configVars BY Timeout(i) DEF Timeout, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, protocolVars
  <2>3. latestConfigIndex' = latestConfigIndex BY <2>2 DEF configVars
  <2>4. latestConfigIndex[s] = LastConfigIndex(log[s]) BY AgentInd DEF AgentInd, AgentLatestLink
  <2>5. QED BY <2>1, <2>3, <2>4 DEF AgentLatestLink
<1>3. ASSUME NEW i \in Server, AgentInd, Timeout(i), NEW s \in Server PROVE AgentConfigCountP(s) <= 1
  <2>1. log' = log BY Timeout(i) DEF Timeout
  <2>2. commitIndex' = commitIndex BY Timeout(i) DEF Timeout
  <2>3. configVars' = configVars BY Timeout(i) DEF Timeout, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, protocolVars
  <2>4. committedConfigIndex' = committedConfigIndex BY <2>3 DEF configVars
  <2>5. AgentConfigCount(s) <= 1 BY AgentInd DEF AgentInd, AgentConfigSafetyAll, AgentConfigCount
  <2>6. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>4, <2>5 DEF AgentConfigCount, AgentConfigCountP
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF AgentInd, AgentTypeOK, AgentLatestLink, AgentConfigSafetyAll, AgentConfigCount, AgentConfigCountP
